title: A site wearing a design system through Tracy's design-system slot is read from the site itself on EmDash, WordPress and Joomla: the agent's context names the system and how to edit relative to it, and tracy_design_check measures against the slot instead of answering that the site wears no design system
steps: S1: No stand, no browser, no model. In the TCH checkout at the commit under test, with dependencies installed (pnpm install) and lib/index.js of @tracy/dsh-site-tools built, run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/ds-slot-worn.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/ds-slot-wiring.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# pass' and '# fail' lines and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: The reads: one per CMS, as www-data in the site's own web container (EmDash node reads /app/data/ds-slot.css; WordPress wp-cli with no plugin or theme code reads the user global styles; Joomla PHP reads the published, assigned mod_custom carrying the marker); the stand's captured payloads parse to Moxie (EmDash, data/ds-slot.css), Voiceflow (WordPress, style variation ds-refero-03b3d707-2a30-4f53-a524) and refero:03b3d707-… (Joomla, module 255 "Tracy design system"); a read that does not answer is unknown, a site wearing nothing is none.

The design line, for each of the three payloads: '- Design system: <name/id>, worn through Tracy's design-system slot — <where>', the slot's variables written by family (`--ds-c-{…}`), every value they cover written relative to them with examples in the CMS's syntax (EmDash `!rounded-[var(--ds-btn-radius,0)]`, `!py-[calc(var(--ds-btn-pad-y,15px)+4px)]`; elsewhere `var(--ds-c-accent)`, `border-radius: var(…)`), the element's leftover literals replaced the same way, `!` only before a slot value, change nothing when already met, a whole new look is another system; no hex; at most 1,400 bytes; it stands where the design line stands and the rest of the context is byte-identical.

The built bundle: a step on an installed EmDash site whose container answers the slot read carries that line, read once in <label>-web-1 as www-data; a site wearing nothing gets no Design system line; tracy_design_check on the slot site answers design {source:'slot'} and never NO_DESIGN_BOUND or 'wears no design system'.
The check against the slot's own tokens: the slot's accent, text colour and display font raise no warning; a skipped measure names the slot and where it lives, not docs/agents/design.json.
evidence: Stand 09–10/10/2026 (dskeepem, dskeepwp, dskeepjo): GET /api/sites/<key>/design answered {"design":null}, no docs/agents/design.json, no 'Design system:' line, tracy_design_check answered NO_DESIGN_BOUND 'This site wears no design system…', every look.set answer said designCheck: skipped. Before/after text and screenshots: tasks/evidence/followups-2026-10-10/p3-design/.
fence: Mechanism only: what the host reads from the site and what text the agent is given. Not covered: whether a model then edits relative to the slot; that is measured by re-running the modify suite on the stand.
